comment: The two refusal patterns a project sets (signal_own_refusal_pattern, signal_provider_refusal_pattern) and the class each host gives a refused model request's text under them: own where the own pattern matches, else provider where the provider's does, else unknown. The Oh My Pi plugin compiles each as new RegExp(pattern, "su") (packages/pi-legion/src/model-requests.ts) and the Claude Code bridge as config.SharedPattern does, regexp.Compile("(?s)" + pattern). The tests for both hosts read this file, so the two hosts class one text alike.

cases.name: provider
cases.text: 429 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"rate_limit_error","message":"the upstream provider's rate limit is reached"}}

cases.name: both patterns match
cases.text: 429 project tokens per minute exceeded; the upstream rate limit is reached as well
